type: ∀ {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (I : Set S) (a b : S), a ∉ I → b ∉ I → a ≠ b → let T : Set S := Set.insert a (Set.insert b I); let parabolicRoots : Set S → Set (Finsupp S Real) := fun L => {α | ∃ w : W, w ∈ CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs L ∧ ∃ i : S, i ∈ L ∧ CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs w (Finsupp.single i (1 : Real)) = α}; let simpleRoots : Set S → Set (Finsupp S Real) := fun L => Set.image (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : Real)) L; let positiveRoots : Set (Finsupp S Real) := {α | α ∈ CoxeterSystem.geometricRoots cs ∧ 0 < α}; let negativeRoots : Set (Finsupp S Real) := {α | α ∈ CoxeterSystem.geometricRoots cs ∧ α < 0}; let D : Set S := {i | i ∈ T ∧ (Relation.ReflTransGen (fun j k : S => j ∈ T ∧ k ∈ T ∧ j ≠ k ∧ M j k ≠ 2) a i ∨ Relation.ReflTransGen (fun j k : S => j ∈ T ∧ k ∈ T ∧ j ≠ k ∧ M j k ≠ 2) b i)}; Set.Finite (parabolicRoots T \ parabolicRoots I) → Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs D) ∧ ∃ wD : CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs D, ∃ wDI : CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs (D ∩ I), (∀ u : CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs D, CoxeterSystem.length cs (u : W) ≤ CoxeterSystem.length cs (wD : W)) ∧ (∀ u : CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs (D ∩ I), CoxeterSystem.length cs (u : W) ≤ CoxeterSystem.length cs (wDI : W)) ∧ (let r : W := (wD : W) * (wDI : W); let q : W := r⁻¹; ∃ K : Set S, K ⊆ T ∧ (∃ g : W, Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj g)) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs K) = CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs I) ∧ Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs r) (simpleRoots I) = simpleRoots K ∧ Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs q) (simpleRoots K) = simpleRoots I ∧ positiveRoots ∩ Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs q) negativeRoots = (parabolicRoots T ∩ positiveRoots) \ (parabolicRoots I ∩ positiveRoots))
